title: Notifications
intro: How notifications of the DHBW Cloud reach {{address}} by mail. Every mail links to this page and can be unsubscribed from directly.
defaults: Nothing saved yet: the defaults apply.
loadFailed: The settings could not be loaded

action.label: Action needed
action.text: A request awaits a decision, a project ends, an allocation has expired. Reminders after 2 and 7 days while nothing has happened.

disruption.label: Disruption that affects you
disruption.text: Something concerning your projects or workspaces failed or was restricted.

info.label: Information
info.text: Good to know, such as an approved request. Never immediately, only in the summary.

digest.title: Summary
digest.text: Collects what does not come immediately into one mail at 8 am. If it holds something that needs action (e.g. beyond the daily limit of 5 mails), it comes the next morning.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.text: No mails during this time; they are delivered afterwards. Deadlines within the next 48 hours come anyway.

types.title: Kinds
types.text: Unticked kinds send no more mail, not even in the summary.
